PRIMA.gloss: indicating the most important performer or role
PRIMA.definition: Indicating the most important performer or role.

PAIR.gloss: a set of two similar things considered as a unit
PAIR.definition: A set of two similar things considered as a unit.

RAMP.gloss: an inclined surface connecting two levels
RAMP.definition: An inclined surface connecting two levels.

AMIR.definition: An independent ruler or chieftain (especially in Africa or Arabia).

AIR.gloss: a mixture of gases required for breathing
AIR.definition: A mixture of gases (especially oxygen) required for breathing; the stuff that the wind consists of.

MAP.definition: Make a map of; show or establish the features of details of.

ARM.definition: A human limb; technically the part of the superior limb between the shoulder and the elbow but commonly used to refer to the whole superior limb.

AIM.gloss: point or cause to go towards
AIM.definition: Point or cause to go (blows, weapons, or objects such as photographic equipment) towards.
AIM.example: Please don't aim at your little brother!

RIP.example: The curtain ripped from top to bottom.

RAM.gloss: strike or drive against with a heavy impact
RAM.definition: Strike or drive against with a heavy impact.
RAM.example: Ram the gate with a sledgehammer.

PAR.gloss: the standard number of strokes set for each hole on a golf course, or for the entire…
PAR.definition: (golf) the standard number of strokes set for each hole on a golf course, or for the entire course.

RAP.gloss: a reproach for some lapse or misdeed
RAP.definition: A reproach for some lapse or misdeed.
RAP.example: He took the blame for it.

RIM.gloss: the shape of a raised edge of a more or less circular object
RIM.definition: The shape of a raised edge of a more or less circular object.

IRA.gloss: belligerence aroused by a real or supposed wrong
IRA.definition: Belligerence aroused by a real or supposed wrong (personified as one of the deadly sins).

AMP.gloss: the basic unit of electric current adopted under the Systeme International d'Unites
AMP.definition: The basic unit of electric current adopted under the Systeme International d'Unites.
AMP.example: A typical household circuit carries 15 to 50 amps.
